name: Wrap Midi Dress
shortDescription: A flattering wrap-front midi dress with a soft flowy skirt.
longDescription: This wrap midi dress is designed to move with you, featuring an adjustable tie waist, flutter sleeves, and a soft rayon blend that drapes beautifully. Perfect for warm-weather occasions like beach weddings, garden parties, or a relaxed dinner date.

name: Tailored Blazer Dress
shortDescription: A blazer-inspired mini dress with sharp tailoring.
longDescription: Part blazer, part dress — this piece has structured shoulders, a notch collar, and a nipped waist for a polished silhouette. Works as a stylish stand-in for a suit at the office or dressed up with heels for evening.

name: Linen Sundress
shortDescription: A breathable linen maxi dress for hot days and travel.
longDescription: Cut from breathable linen, this maxi dress has a smocked back bodice and adjustable straps for all-day comfort. An easy pick for beach vacations, warm-weather weddings, or wandering a new city.

name: Velvet Slip Dress
shortDescription: A luxe velvet slip dress for evening occasions.
longDescription: Cut on the bias for a subtle body-skimming fit, this velvet slip dress catches the light beautifully. Ideal for holiday parties, cocktail events, or any night that calls for a bit of shine.

name: Floral Wrap Mini Dress
shortDescription: A cheerful floral mini with a flattering wrap silhouette.
longDescription: This lightweight cotton poplin dress features an all-over floral print, a wrap tie waist, and short puff sleeves. A go-to for daytime events like brunches, bridal showers, or garden parties.

name: Knit Sweater Dress
shortDescription: A cozy ribbed knit dress that works from desk to dinner.
longDescription: Soft ribbed knit hugs the body in all the right places while staying warm enough for cold offices and chilly evenings. Pair with boots and a coat for an easy winter uniform.

name: Satin Slip Maxi Dress
shortDescription: A liquid-drape satin maxi for formal occasions.
longDescription: Cut in a bias-cut silhouette that skims the body, this satin maxi dress has a cowl neckline and adjustable straps. A dependable choice for wedding guest duty or any formal invitation.

name: Denim Shirt Dress
shortDescription: A button-front denim dress with a belted waist.
longDescription: A wardrobe staple with a full button placket, chest pockets, and a self-tie belt to define the waist. Wear open over a tee and jeans or buttoned up on its own for easy weekend style.

name: Silk Cami Top
shortDescription: A silky camisole that layers under blazers or stands alone.
longDescription: This adjustable-strap silk cami is cut with a slight relaxed fit for easy layering under blazers, cardigans, or worn alone tucked into tailored trousers.

name: Oversized Poplin Shirt
shortDescription: A crisp oversized button-down for effortless layering.
longDescription: An oversized fit through the body and sleeves gives this poplin shirt a relaxed, borrowed-from-the-boyfriend feel. Wear tucked, knotted, or open over a tank.

name: Ribbed Turtleneck
shortDescription: A fitted ribbed turtleneck for cold-weather layering.
longDescription: Soft ribbed knit with a touch of stretch, this turtleneck is warm enough to wear alone under a blazer and thin enough to layer under sweaters or coats without bulk.

name: Puff Sleeve Blouse
shortDescription: A blouse with dramatic puff sleeves and a fitted cuff.
longDescription: Voluminous puff sleeves taper to a fitted cuff on this lightweight voile blouse, adding a feminine statement to office looks or daytime outings.

name: Cropped Rib Tank
shortDescription: A cropped ribbed tank for everyday layering.
longDescription: A simple, well-fitted cropped tank in stretchy ribbed cotton — pairs easily with high-waisted jeans, skirts, or under an open shirt.

name: Merino Wool Sweater
shortDescription: A crewneck merino wool sweater for warmth without bulk.
longDescription: Fine-gauge merino wool keeps you warm without adding bulk, making this crewneck sweater easy to layer under coats or wear on its own with tailored trousers.

name: Linen Button-Up Shirt
shortDescription: A breathable linen shirt for warm-weather wear.
longDescription: Lightweight linen with a relaxed fit makes this button-up ideal for hot climates — wear open over a swimsuit, tucked into shorts, or tied at the waist.

name: High-Waisted Wide Leg Trousers
shortDescription: Fluid wide-leg trousers with a high-waisted fit.
longDescription: Cut from a fluid crepe with a crisp center crease, these wide-leg trousers sit high on the waist and skim over the hips for a polished, elongating silhouette suited to the office or evenings out.

name: Straight Leg Jeans
shortDescription: A classic straight-leg jean with a hint of stretch.
longDescription: A dependable everyday jean with a high rise and straight leg that works with sneakers, boots, or heels alike. Just enough stretch for all-day comfort.

name: Pleated Midi Skirt
shortDescription: A fluid pleated midi skirt with movement.
longDescription: Fine accordion pleats catch the light and add movement to this midi skirt, which sits at the natural waist. Dress it up with heels or wear casually with a tee and sneakers.

name: Tailored Shorts
shortDescription: Crisp tailored shorts with a menswear-inspired cut.
longDescription: These tailored shorts feature a flat front, belt loops, and a mid-thigh length that reads polished rather than casual. Great for warm-weather office days or travel.

name: Faux Leather Leggings
shortDescription: Sleek faux leather leggings with a stretch fit.
longDescription: A stretch faux leather fabric gives these high-waisted leggings a second-skin fit with the edge of leather and the comfort of a legging. Pair with an oversized sweater for balance.

name: A-Line Denim Skirt
shortDescription: A knee-length A-line denim skirt.
longDescription: A classic five-pocket denim skirt with an A-line cut that skims the hips and falls to the knee. An easy building block for casual daytime outfits.

name: Wool Blend Overcoat
shortDescription: A longline wool-blend overcoat for cold weather.
longDescription: This double-breasted overcoat is cut from a warm wool blend with a longline silhouette that layers over blazers, sweaters, and dresses alike. A cold-weather essential built to last.

name: Cropped Denim Jacket
shortDescription: A cropped denim jacket that layers over anything.
longDescription: A cropped length keeps this denim jacket from bulking up your silhouette — perfect thrown over dresses, tanks, or tees for cool evenings.

name: Quilted Puffer Jacket
shortDescription: A lightweight but warm quilted puffer jacket.
longDescription: Filled with recycled insulation, this puffer jacket is warm without being bulky, with a stand collar and zip pockets. Built for cold commutes and winter travel.

name: Trench Coat
shortDescription: A timeless belted trench coat.
longDescription: A double-breasted trench with a storm flap, belted waist, and water-resistant cotton gabardine — a classic layer for transitional weather and rainy commutes.

name: Oversized Cardigan
shortDescription: A slouchy oversized cardigan for easy layering.
longDescription: A relaxed, oversized fit and dropped shoulders make this cardigan easy to throw over dresses, tanks, or button-downs. Deep patch pockets and a long length add to the cozy factor.

name: Faux Fur Collar Vest
shortDescription: A quilted vest with a plush faux fur collar.
longDescription: This quilted vest brings a touch of glamour to cold-weather dressing with its plush faux fur collar, worn easily over sweaters or dresses for holiday gatherings.

name: Woven Leather Tote Bag
shortDescription: A woven leather tote with room for daily essentials.
longDescription: Hand-woven leather panels give this tote texture and durability, with an interior zip pocket and a structured base that keeps its shape whether you're commuting or traveling.

name: Silk Scarf
shortDescription: A printed silk scarf to elevate any outfit.
longDescription: A lightweight silk square scarf that can be worn around the neck, tied to a bag handle, or used as a hair accessory — an easy way to add color and polish to a simple outfit.

name: Statement Gold Hoop Earrings
shortDescription: Bold gold hoop earrings that dress up any look.
longDescription: Lightweight despite their bold scale, these gold-plated hoops add instant polish to jeans-and-tee outfits or evening looks alike.
